report.summary: Login failures and missing OTP issues starting around 13:40 are caused by external vendor service 'otp-provider' returning 503 Service Unavailable errors.

supporting.note: Logs show 503 Service Unavailable errors from otp-provider starting at 13:40:13
Auth-service error rate spikes abruptly to over 34% at 13:40
Mobile-bff error rate spikes starting at 13:41 due to auth failures

ranked_hypotheses.title: Regression introduced in auth-service deployment v7.1.3

supporting.note: auth-service was deployed at 13:05, shortly before the incident

contradicting.note: Error rate remained normal for 35 minutes after the deploy before spiking at 13:40
Direct error logs cite external 503 Service Unavailable from otp-provider rather than an internal exception

facts.text: auth-service error rate anomaly started at 2026-10-13T13:40:00+00:00.
mobile-bff error rate anomaly started at 2026-10-13T13:41:00+00:00.
auth-service logs show otp-provider responding with 503 Service Unavailable errors starting at 2026-10-13T13:40:13+00:00.

assumptions: The 503 Service Unavailable responses are generated by the third-party otp-provider infrastructure and not an internal reverse proxy.
evidence_gaps: Direct observability metrics and server-side logs from the external vendor service otp-provider are not available.

timeline.event: auth-service error rate begins to spike.
First log entry indicating otp-provider 503 Service Unavailable appears.
mobile-bff error rate begins to spike.
Incident reported by on-call SRE Priya.

recommended_actions.action: Escalate to the third-party OTP provider vendor regarding 503 service availability failures.
recommended_actions.rationale: External vendor is failing to serve OTP requests.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers and secondary fallback providers for OTP delivery.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents downstream auth-service and mobile-bff failures during vendor outages.
